subject: Kimonix’s Japan rollout for Shopify fashion retailers
body:
Hi Kimonix team,

We’re A-one Road, a Yokohama-based company supporting technology businesses in Japan. We see a specific opportunity for Kimonix in automating collection sorting for Japanese Shopify fashion retailers, which is why we’re reaching out.

Japan’s May 2026 labour survey recorded staffing shortages at 34% of wholesale/retail establishments. Automating repetitive collection sorting gives fashion teams a concrete way to reduce manual merchandising workloads.

We can lead a year of paid Japan market development: assess retailer requirements, shape a localized adoption plan, and develop partner channels around this workflow. Direct evidence from Japanese buyers will guide the practical introduction strategy and subsequent expansion. Can we help build Kimonix’s Japan rollout around this segment?

https://calendar.app.google/adKEhXC4UWhQXfJp6

Best regards,
Kazuma Tamura
Founder & CEO, A-one Road Co., Ltd. (Yokohama, Japan)
